rootCause: The governed BG169 production path requires an explicit non-verification workflow_dispatch carrying immutable PR identity, while the active ChatGPT GitHub connector exposes read/rerun operations but no workflow-dispatch mutation; the alternate Make authority route became unavailable in-session.
handling: Never reinterpret a successful pull_request verification run as BG169 production promotion evidence.
Never substitute manual merge, ordinary workflow rerun or an unrelated transport for the required explicit production-authority dispatch.
Preserve exact PR/base/head/branch identity and the verified gate evidence as one open outcome obligation.
Resume only through the canonical explicit production-authority route when a capable connector or runner is available, then require fresh main readback before closure.
If a state-changing connector call returns an ambiguous transport error, read back state before one bounded retry.
